visualReview.correctedResultParagraph: With the isolated frequency correction, the PAL intro plays and disk two reaches its menu at field 11,000. That handoff succeeds before the failing-baseline and corrected scripts first differ at field 11,200. No disk bytes, guest state or ROM bytes were patched.
visualReview.gameplayParagraph: Both Kickstart and corrected CopperStart show the intro credits, portrait briefing, disk-two menu and opening street gameplay through field 22,000. The idle controls establish the response to the recorded steering sequence. Seven of eight selected full-viewport RGB images match between ROMs: the menu at 11,000 and 11,200, and gameplay at 14,000, 14,600, 15,600, 18,000 and 22,000. The field-13,000 transitional wipe differs. These cross-ROM observations are separate from the stricter equality checks within each CPU-mode pair.
visualReview.regressionParagraph: The fresh-ROM Lotus 2 regression retains all 161 earlier images and sampled PCM files across 16,000 fields. The opening race reaches 61 MPH and 47,890 points at field 13,000, with the later title return retained at 16,000. Arte retains all 101 earlier images and sampled PCM files through 40,000 fields, including credits at 24,000, the textured scene at 32,000 and the intro return at 40,000. Some state and RAM captures differ with the firmware change; full cross-ROM capture identity is not claimed.
visualReview.method: Complete 908x313 viewports reviewed in labelled JPEG viewing copies at original dimensions, quality98/no subsampling, no cropping or scaling; raw BMP/RGB comparisons are authoritative.
limits: Opening gameplay only; no later-level or complete-game claim.
No physical NTSC, audio-fidelity or host-throughput qualification.
